notes.title: The RTS Fest Demo is now available
notes.content:
In celebration of RTS Fest, we are excited to give you a preview of [b]Platoon Commander[/b], a game currently in the early stages of development.
Your feedback on the demo will be crucial in helping us improve and refine the game.

Platoon Commander is a [b]Real-Time Wargame[/b] focused on the German advance toward Moscow in the fall and winter of 1941. It combines real-time tactical battles with a turn-based campaign map. You can make decisions about the pace of the advance, switch to defensive strategies when necessary, and manage your army, considering weather conditions and the passing of time.
[previewyoutube=irv5qm7eS1o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What’s included in the demo[/h3]
The demo offers a significant experience of Platoon Commander’s first mission, where players step into the role of a German Commander during the autumn of 1941. Tasked with capturing and holding a Soviet village, players will customize their platoons by choosing a mix of infantry, armor, and artillery to defend against the inevitable Soviet counterattack.

You can access it by visiting the Platoon Commander Steam page and clicking on the "[u]Download[/u]" button.
The demo will be available for one week, so don’t miss your chance to experience this World War II RTS. Click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1536440/discussions/0/578250175151110418/]here [/url]to read first tutorial of the demo.
You can also join Platoon Commander's Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/yM29mcr5qj]https://discord.gg/yM29mcr5qj[/url]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Realistic Visibility Mechanics: advanced visibility calculation system for different types of troops, tied to landscape types.
[*] Fully Interactive Environments: it is possible to destroy buildings, decimate forests with artillery fire, or crush obstacles like fences using tanks to reshape the battlefield.
[*] Psychological Simulation of Troops: morale and psychological states influence unit performance under fire, adding depth to troop management.
[*] Artillery and Smoke Screens: possibility of requesting artillery support and setting up smoke screens
[*] Sophisticated Ballistic Model: accurate physics-based mechanics, including ricochets and realistic armor penetration, ensuring tank warfare feels authentic.
[/list]
[b]Demo Units List[/b]
[b]Red Army units[/b]:
[list]
[*] PTRS and PTRD anti-tank rifle units
[*] M-30 122-mm howitzer
[*] T-26 and T-34'41 tanks
[*] Mosin and PPSh-41 infantry
[/list]
[b]Wehrmacht units:[/b]
[list]
[*] Panzerbuchse 1939 anti-tank rifle squad
[*] 3.7cm Pak 36 anti-tank gun
[*] Pz.Kpfw. III F tank
[*] Kar98k and MP 40 infantry
[/list]
The full game will feature an even broader selection.
